text:
La Gazzetta dello Sport
Goals for everyone
Lazio get six, over to Inter today
Gattuso show with two missed penalties, he returns to the top on his own against Sassuolo
Bonny in attack, Pio tries: In Venezia to catch up with the leaders
What a Roma side, boys
Lulli, Pisilli and Mora score. Cagliari beaten by the youngsters
Adams launches a good Toro team, Paz inspires a grand finale from Como
Milan thinking about the derby
Without the big guns against Bologna, Cisse will be there
Juve in giant mode, Woltemade now untouchable
Away against Genoa today
Corriere dello Sport
Rinolandia
Sassuolo demolished with six goals: Inter -3 and are in Venezia today
A Lazio side to go crazy for | They win 6-2 in Reggio Emilia in front of 10,000 fans while missing two penalties: fifth away victory in a row now alone in first place
Taylor unlocks it and Noslin (brace) closes. Isaksen, Floriani and Zaccagni also on target. Thorstvedt sent off at 3-1 after 31 minutes. Gattuso: ‘Our dream is a full Olimpico’
All on Woltemade
Lucio changes at Marassi (19.45): Kolo out, the German steps forward
Juve chasing their third away win: An opportunity for Nick, who is looking for his first league goal to add to the three he has in the Europa League. Spalletti wants maturity: ‘It’s a tough game. Genoa have the right spirit and De Rossi’s tenacity. The players didn’t ask for the 3-5-2 formation’
Mora and Malen: Infinite Roma
A crazy end: From 2-2 to 4-2 in two minutes against Cagliari
Fabregas fights back against Toro and is fourth
Como win 3-1
Adams lights up for Abate, then Jacobo Ramon, Nico Paz and Baturina seal the comeback. Cesc catches up to Milan in the standings and remains five points off the lead
Ramos then Cisse: Milan push
Against Bologna at 17.30
Looking for their third consecutive victory. Gila, Rabiot and Moreira won’t make it. Modric likely to be on the bench. Pulisic renewal until 2031
Napoli, Allegri without fear
In Monza at 19.45
Max backs down in his fight against his two-match ban and turns to Lucca, Lobotka and Marianucci. De Bruyne rested
Tuttosport
Toro in there with Che, but Paz is magic
A great Granata first half, then Como dominate but risk collapsing on multiple counter attacks. That’s until Nico Paz came up with two fantastic plays
A spirited performance from Abate’s side, who went ahead through Adams and were cheered on by their supporters until the end, was undone by the genius of the Argentine: Sublime assist for Ramon and a great header to seal the comeback, completed in injury time by Baturina. Fabregas returns to fourth place
Juve, no stopping until the break
Away against Genoa (19.45), Spalletti is still obliged to win
He needs to confirm it after the success in Lecce. Going ahead with the 3-5-2: Alajbegovic plays alongside Kolo Muani. Lucio: ‘The players don’t choose the formation, I would never disrespect them like that. Kolo? It’s not just goals that count: Look at what else he does’
Lazio, crazy 6. And who’s stopping you?
Gattuso’s squad is still a spectacle: They even missed two penalties. Another victory on the road: Today, Inter need to respond in Venezia. Mora and Malen come on and give Roma a victory against Cagliari
